checkResults.note: Expo 57.0.9 / RN 0.86.2 / client 0.1.7 / iOS 26.3.1 sim / release artifact sha d2fcb80ae449…; all identities recorded.

Clean release launch through the supported path (expo run:ios artifact via simctl); fresh signed-out boot witnessed on-device. The consumer WebCrypto polyfill remains the prerequisite (0137-a1expo-f1, cited — not re-filed).

In-app email-code entry (guide auth/native-apps.md shape 1) executed on-device; deep-link return exercised FOR REAL on this contract: simctl openurl delivered sweepshell://invite?code=INV-HOST-2214 to the running app, which redeemed it through the authority-creating mutation — settlement {role host, enteredVia deep-link}, roster attribution verified independently, invite consumed, replay by another principal refused. Headless caveat: iOS's one-time scheme-confirmation dialog must be pre-approved in the simulator schemeapproval plist (finding 0137-a4expo-f2, guide-gap).

Seeded event rendered authoritative on-device (6/12 seats, 3 wall posts, member-only address) and independently verified; anonymous preview excludes the address; outsider denied (SNAPBACK_AUTH_PERMISSION_DENIED). Second-device transitions over server push: gil's wall post visible on-device ≤122ms and his RSVP raised the on-device seat count to 7/12 ≤122ms after settlement, wall author attributed to the server principal. a1expo-f7's indefinite connection cycling did NOT reproduce on this all-protected-query surface (one early spontaneous cycle, then a 16s stable live hold — narrowing note appended to the f7 ticket).

Background via Settings launch (inactive witnessed), second-device wall post while backgrounded caught up on foreground; network loss (origin refusing) left rendered posts retained under a non-live connection fact, never relabeled live; reconnect returned live and a fresh commit flowed.

Cold process restart with the backend unreachable is clean (app-keychain bearer survived; honest 'backend unreachable' state; self-healed to the authoritative render 3.1s after the origin returned). Protected retained state is NOT CLAIMED on this carrier (Online surface; default rqs store resolves to the in-memory arm, durable:false) — GAP owned by 0137-a1expo-f3 (cited, not re-filed).

Queue unclaimed on this carrier (Online surface) and the documented offlineQueue opt-in still cannot engage: the offline postWall surfaced the raw Expo fetch Error (plain Error, not TypeError) and queued nothing — 0137-a1expo-f2 re-verified on this arm (dated note appended to the ticket, not re-filed). No ghost settlement (wall count unchanged, no offline clientKey ever committed); online server-refused RSVP surfaced structured.

File selection/upload proven from the device: deterministic PNG treated as the selected file, uploaded on-device over the raw attempt/TUS/finalize recipe (expo/fetch Uint8Array body + on-device sha256 checksum; the packaged client still ships no upload helper — 0137-a1-f3 cited), published ready; card/thumb renditions and the strict no-store primary read back on-device (served digest stable across reads and byte-identical to the a4-web arm's for the same fixture — strip re-encodes canonical bytes); the RN Image component rendered the flyer through the per-request-authorized byte lane (witnessed onLoad + screenshot); anonymous byte read refused; public preview hasFlyer=true. The non-owner hole persists on 0.1.7 and is cited, not re-filed: typed attach refuses SNAPBACK_ASSET_REF_UNVERIFIED (0137-a1-f2) and a seated guest's strict read is 403 (0137-a4-f3); the post-0.1.7 main fixes (117dcae2) are not in this arm's pinned packages.

Explicit GAP: no push-notification boundary on 0.1.7 — capability manifest notifications:false, no device-token/APNs/FCM/expo-notifications lane in the packaged closure or guide, and the app-authored bridge is unauthorable because the outbound effect lane is broken on the pinned packages (0137-a4-f1; main fix 117dcae2 post-publication). Mobile-scoped finding filed: 0137-a4expo-f1.

Evidenced defect, re-verified 0137-a1expo-f4 (cited; dated note appended to the ticket, not re-filed): rotation to a seatless outsider blanked predecessor rows (correct) but rejected with the lifecycle-failures AggregateError while the successor denial never reached the hook (query left 'refreshing'), and rotate-back to the original authority never re-subscribed — connection wedged 'disconnected' with queries presenting ready/0 rows until process exit. Logout and retirement are correct: rows blanked, app keychain custody cleared, relaunch boots signed-out with no predecessor data at rest (no durable client store on this carrier).

App terminated and uninstalled; simulator shut down; snapback dev stopped (origin refuses); flyer asset deleted (200 → next read 404); seats self-removed (membership unseedable/unresettable — 0137-a3-f1 cited); receipted versioned reset-install (reset-installed, 20 rows deleted, literal fixture restored: anonymous preview 6/12 with hasFlyer=false) and a fresh session's protected read denied post-cleanup.
